# The Medford Center For Orthodontics & Pediatric Dentistry

> A comprehensive dental practice in Medford, MA specializing in orthodontics, pediatric dentistry, and specialized care for children and special needs patients.

The Medford Center is led by Dr. Eric Gheewalla (orthodontist) and Dr. AnnaMarie DeFeo (pediatric dentist), along with Dr. Anna Lam, offering both traditional and modern treatment options including Invisalign clear aligners, ceramic braces, and pediatric dental services. The practice serves the greater Boston area with expertise from board-certified specialists affiliated with Tufts University School of Dental Medicine.

- [Braces FAQ](https://www.themedfordcenter.com/orthodontics/braces-faqs): FAQ about traditional braces care, maintenance, and treatment.
